backend: Pinned AnyJev hidden-state backend with local Transformers 5.17.0 Qwen3 no-cache block-loop compatibility adapter
outer_design: Reuse exact label-blind five folds, each 48 train and12 held out, contrast pairs kept together. No new records.
inner_cv_note: Pinned native inner CV shuffles the48 outer-training rows without grouping. All model/head/layer/temperature selection stays inside outer training. Report inner NLL only as a tuning criterion, never unbiased generalization.
prompt_inputs: Same fixed policy/question_specs as original AnyJev L0; feedback only, no per-record labels or generation metadata. Verify source/policy/options/artifact hashes before execution.
label_boundary: A fresh decider per outer fold. Each question fit receives only48 corresponding training labels. Held-out labels inaccessible to fit or model request construction. Labels are numerical supervised head targets and are never interpolated into model prompts. Score only saved held-out outputs offline.
held_out_prediction: Use public decide at level L2 with fitted fold artifacts. Every DEV id has exactly one held-out prediction per question; preserve probabilities, selected layer/head, class support and raw diagnostics.
smoke_gate: Before full60 held-out prediction collection, inspect DEV001-003 out-of-fold native results and prompt/label isolation evidence. Fit only the outer-training sets necessary for those smoke predictions. Preserve head artifacts for subsequent full run; never automatically rerun ambiguous work.
failure_policy: Keep canonical60 denominator. Stop on source/artifact drift, leakage, context overflow, runtime failure or invalid probability dimensions. Preserve intrinsic failures and all partial work without repairs.
sample_size_limitation: 48 training labels per outer fold exceeds native minimum max(8,2K) but is below documented100-300 recommended examples. Exploratory CV only; no deployed head claimed. Missing classes remain explicit without changing folds/options or adding labels.
verification_required: Spy on all fit calls:20 fits total, each only its48 outer-train IDs/labels, no held-out IDs
Capture actual model prompts to prove no reference-label interpolation
Canonical60 OOF coverage and pair-group integrity
Artifact import and hashes, runtime device/dtype, context no truncation
Meaningful offline test rejects deliberate train-test leakage
Root inspection of smoke before full60
One local GPU lane; no concurrent LM Studio prediction run

supersedes.reason: First v2 smoke stopped at first fit_head due native Transformers 5.17.0 causal-mask API mismatch; zero fits and zero predictions completed.

compatibility_note: The adapter changes only the pinned AnyJev block-loop calls to match installed Qwen3Model.forward: inputs_embeds mask argument, no obsolete cache_position mask argument, no-cache prefill, and decoder past_key_values/use_cache arguments. Benchmark controls, folds, prompts, labels and output schema remain the v2 design. Results must identify this configuration separately.

failed_v2_smoke.disposition: terminal stopped; original evidence preserved; no automatic retry
